summary: Help Center Migration Testing Complete - Iteration 7. Successfully verified migration from static frontend data to dynamic backend APIs. All endpoints working correctly: GET /api/help/categories-full (8 categories), GET /api/help/faq (20 items), GET /api/help/troubleshooting (10 guides), GET /api/help/shortcuts (5 categories), GET /api/help/whats-new (4 releases), GET /api/help/search (search functionality). Frontend correctly fetches and displays all data from backend APIs.
